name.en-US: St. Teresa Benedicta of the Cross

patronOf.en-US: Virgin and martyr, co-patron of Europe
patronOf.pt-BR: Virgem e mártir, copadroeira da Europa

prayerExcerpt.en-US: That the whole human race may acknowledge Christ as its Savior.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Que todas as pessoas reconheçam o Cristo Salvador.

meta.face: A mature woman of about forty-seven (NOT a young girl): a strong, broad, square-jawed face with high cheekbones, thick dark straight eyebrows, deep-set dark intelligent eyes, a straight nose and full, composed lips; a grave, thoughtful, scholarly expression with a faint gentle warmth. She must look clearly older and more serious than Thérèse and Teresa of Ávila.
meta.basis: Her photographs, above all the passport photograph taken at the door of the Cologne Carmel in 1938–39: dark heavy brows, deep-set dark eyes, a strong nose and a grave expression. She died at fifty.

sources.title: Wikimedia Commons, Edith Stein, passport photograph, Cologne Carmel (c. 1938–39)
